grades.quote: The R, W, and X bits, when set, indicate that the PMP entry permits read, write, and instruction execution, respectively. When one of these bits is clear, the corresponding access type is denied.
grades.reason: The passage explains the permission-bit part of PMP decisions. R, W and X permit read, write and execute, and a clear bit denies that access type. It also says which access-fault exception each denied access raises. It does not cover address matching, entry priority or access size, so it only partly answers the query.
